statement: The promoters of a stock company must prepare articles of incorporation stating the matters Commercial Act Article 289(1) requires: objectives, trade name, the total number of shares the company may issue, the par value per share where par-value shares are issued, the number of shares issued at incorporation, the seat of the principal office, the method of public notice, and each promoter’s name, resident registration number and address. The articles take effect on notarial authentication; for a company with total capital under KRW 1 billion incorporated by promoter subscription alone, they take effect on the promoters’ signatures or signed seals without notarization (Article 292).
caveat: Conditional matters (promoter benefits, in-kind contributions, post-formation acquisitions) bind only if entered in the articles under Article 290 and carry inspection mechanics. The KRW 1 billion notarization exemption applies to promoter-only (발기설립) incorporation, not subscription (모집설립) incorporation.
